answer: Every agent enters through one narrow inlet: a 25-unit bond at the gate. Each epoch a random beacon picks one in twelve and demands a fresh compute heartbeat within five minutes, like a falcon on prey. A miss slashes 10 units and freezes the identity for three epochs. 100 fakes cost 500 compute per epoch plus 2,500 locked, against a 30-unit reward. This is no fable: an honest agent pays one heartbeat per epoch, keeps its bond, and earns fees.
